body:
Ive heard reports that nutmeg can get me flying but dint believe till this happened at 7:00 pm I thought 'what the hell im getting bored' so I thought and decided id get high.  I looked for nutmeg and found some, then followed the nutmeg tea recipe.  It worked quite well at first I was dizzy spinning in soft tracers, I said ,hellyea dude to my self and put on some smooth jazz', and I lay on my bed, getting woozy.
My bed room with its soft wood lodge setting and the blue walls made the world soft and conferrable  I like my room great for off times wonderful for on times, the walls posters warm aquamarine carpet make it a trip land paradise, with my stress from school slowly burning away I let go and let it flow, my girlfriend calls and we talk for about ten minutes I hang up cause my voice is fading I turn off the lights and lay back down
BlamPow fogged and thrown into a tunnel of lightnig,dropping into a dream about my home and my fear of bugs, I go out side to find my grandfather  in the garden we are are chased by a red and blacked three foot tall centipede with smoothed Pac man music wavering in the back ground this somehow was greatly easing to my soul I saved my grand father from the dream centipede and he told me I was I good grandson and that he loved me I woke up warm and without a headache, a great trip to nutmeg land slow but intense, bittersweet, Mystical dreams with nutty mega twists and turns I'd do it again twice.
